subject: Ram Gopal
caveat: Single-register sample. Targets are provisional for prose registers.

provisional_targets._provenance: NOT measured on Ram's corpus. Derived from the direction of the Economist July 2026 study (generated text under-punctuates, over-coordinates, over-nominalises). Bands are first estimates and need calibration against a real Ram sample before they are trusted. Lint applies them; treat breaches as prompts to look, not as faults.

vocabulary_conflict.status: resolved: ban list wins (Ram, Jul 2026) - strip from all drafts including his own
vocabulary_conflict.note: 22 anti-ai-writing banned words appear in Ram's own unassisted writing.

punctuation_note: Commas and parens were already measured in v1.0 but sat outside targets, so lint never reported them. Promoted in v1.1 on the Economist finding that under-punctuation is now a stronger marker of generated prose than em-dash overuse. The low bound is the one that matters; the high bound only catches runaway subordination.
